description.p: Alacritty is a fast, cross-platform, OpenGL terminal emulator. It focuses on simplicity and performance, deferring features like tabs and splits to a window manager or terminal multiplexer.

This is an unofficial Flatpak package, not published or endorsed by the Alacritty project. Because a sandboxed terminal would otherwise trap you inside the Flatpak runtime's filesystem, this build ships a configuration that hands the login shell off to the host via flatpak-spawn. The GPU and UI process stay sandboxed; the shell session runs on the host.

Restores the terminal type: TERM and COLORTERM never reached the shell, so there was no colour and clear, less, tput and every other ncurses program failed. Falls back to xterm-256color on hosts that do not know this terminal.

New windows now open in the current directory, Ctrl+scroll zooms, the shell is the host's own login shell rather than always bash, and the window carries the application ID so the desktop shell matches it to its launcher.

Fixes job control in the host shell. Launching the shell through flatpak-spawn handed the controlling terminal to the proxy process rather than to the shell, so Ctrl+Z, fg and bg silently did nothing, tty could not name the terminal, and window resizes never reached running programs. The shell now goes through a PTY relay that leaves the terminal unclaimed so the portal can hand it to the shell, and which forwards SIGWINCH.
First packaged release. Builds Alacritty v0.17.0 from source.
